name: Vanlife Planner
author: EvKoh
description: Road trips with a rooftop tent, a campervan or a motorhome: legal nights, sunset-safe arrivals, routes, schedules, amenities, host contacts and night status, as MCP tools.

settings.label: Vehicle
settings.hint: Decides which nights are legal: opening a rooftop tent is camping; sleeping inside a van without deploying anything is parking.

settings.label: Vehicle height (m)
Vehicle length (m)

Travelling with a dog

Arrive at the night at least this many minutes before sunset
Water reserve (litres)

mcpTools.name: vanlife_plan_trip
mcpTools.title: Plan or re-plan a vanlife road trip (all-in-one)
mcpTools.description: All-in-one planner for a road trip with a rooftop tent, a campervan or a motorhome (the user's setting). With tripId: full check, challenges each night (cheaper legal night nearby), day routes, schedules from real drive times (arrive the configured margin before sunset), budget total (nights, fuel, tolls incl. places' access tolls), overloaded days from visit durations, possible savings; returns a report, an ordered action list and the core TREK calls to make (reorder_day_assignments, update_assignment_time, create_budget_item). When "continuation" is returned, call again with it until it is null. apply=false (default) only proposes; apply=true also writes the day route places. Without tripId, pass "request" (destination, dates, wishes) for the steps to create the trip. Research what is marked "toVerify" on official sites first; vanlife_host_message drafts a question to a host. Never book, pay or send a message to a host for the user: show them the exact text first and act only on their explicit validation.

apply.description: false = propose only (default). true = also write the day route places.

continuation.description: Opaque token from the previous call, to resume.

request.description: For a trip not yet in TREK.

mcpTools.name: vanlife_check_trip
mcpTools.title: Check a vanlife trip for problems
mcpTools.description: Read-only check of a trip, by day, for the user's vehicle. blocking: arrival after sunset minus margin or unknown, access closed, place closed, night the vehicle may not use (aire for a tent, record refusal, size). fix: impossible times, overlaps, road open only later, route place, shopping detour, dry nights, overloaded day, hike walk not from one car park; bookings tied to no night, cancelled night still planned, booked price unlike the plan, "waiting" notes on a confirmed booking; stale budget lines or to-dos, lodging total unlike the nights'. verify: what free notes say (tent, dog, minimum stay, hours, check-in; quoted); booking required, none recorded; confirmed with no number; no way to reach the host or host silent over 3 days; private/wild/unknown ground; closure in the notes; after sunset; price over the ceiling or unknown; visit duration unknown; cheaper legal night; backtracking. info: margins, price over target, farm zone. Fix what is certain; ask about choices. Never book, pay or message.

language.description: Message language, TREK code (default: the user setting).

sun.description: Also return sunrise, sunset and latest arrival for each night.

mcpTools.name: vanlife_find_nights
mcpTools.title: Find cheap legal nights for the vehicle
mcpTools.description: Night candidates between the evening's last visit and the next morning's first stop, from OpenStreetMap and, if the instance enables it, park4night (unofficial API; nothing stored; each result links to its page). Kinds follow the vehicle: campsites and farms for a rooftop tent; also motorhome areas for a van or a motorhome, and park4night's car parks to verify. With sunset and latest arrival when a date is known; ranked: forbidden last, then legal risk, then a detour over 60 min, then price, then the real detour in drive minutes; with total cost (night + fuel of the detour) and the saving versus the current night. Give tripId + dayNumber (the evening's day), or evening lat/lng (+ morning). Each candidate gives the contacts OSM knows (email, phone, website). OSM has no reviews and rarely prices: each candidate lists what to verify. Compare chains of nights, not one at a time. Never book, pay or send a message to a host for the user: show them the exact text first and act only on their explicit validation.

dayNumber.description: Day number in the trip (1 = first day).

radius_km.description: Search radius around the midpoint (km); at least 5, and wide enough to reach both the evening and the morning stop.

sources.description: Default: osm, plus park4night when the instance enables it.

mcpTools.name: vanlife_day
mcpTools.title: One day of the trip: routes, schedule or supplies
mcpTools.description: Work on the days of a trip; pick "action". "routes": road route of each day with Valhalla for the vehicle (height; length and weight for a motorhome; no tolls except on the motorway days set by the user): km, drive time and legs per day; apply=false (default) proposes, apply=true recreates each day's route place in TREK (the old one is deleted) and returns the core reorder_day_assignments calls; resume with startAt when "continuation" is returned. "schedule": start and end of every stop of one day (dayNumber) from real drive times, opening hours in the notes, arrival at the night against sunset minus the margin; with no departure given, moves it to meet places' access_before/access_after (else a conflict); returns the core update_assignment_time calls; read-only. "supplies": supermarkets, fuel and drinking water along one day's route (dayNumber), distance off the route, hours on that date and whether open at the pass time; read-only. Re-run vanlife_check_trip after a change.

action.description: routes = road geometry of the days; schedule = times of one day; supplies = shops, fuel and water along one day.

items.description: Day number in the trip (1 = first day).

apply.description: routes: false = propose only (default); true = write the route places.

startAt.description: routes: resume index from a previous continuation.

departure.description: schedule: departure from last night's place (default: keep the current plan, else the day_start setting).

at.description: supplies: expected pass time, to tell which places are open then.

corridor_km.description: supplies: max distance off the route (km).

mcpTools.name: vanlife_place
mcpTools.title: Everything about a place: amenities, price, contacts, exchanges
mcpTools.description: Keep what TREK has no field for on a place: amenities, price details, visit duration, timed access, the host's contacts and exchanges. Without placeId: list places by "filter" within "scope" (default: planned nights; counts per scope). With placeId: read one; "set" records fields (price on TREK price, unit "per" — never night for a museum, lake or car park — and "price_note", a free formula; visit minutes; access_before/access_after "HH:MM", booking_required (+ booking_url, booking_note), toll_amount per vehicle (+ toll_currency); a hike's "walk" (car park, points, loop); amenities yes/no/unknown; null erases a field); "log" adds an exchange; "clear_fields" named fields (all: the whole record); "fill" fills empty amenities, contacts and a stated visit duration from the place's notes and TREK fields, OpenStreetMap and park4night, citing each source (a platform page is never a website). Record only what a cited source states; never book, pay or message a host unvalidated.

placeId.description: TREK place id. Omit to list places.

create.description: Without placeId: a new place first, then set/log apply to it: { name, lat, lng, kind (e.g. "hike", "parking"), address, website, description, notes, price_amount, currency, per, day_number (plans it that day) }. A whole hike in one call: create { kind "hike" } + set.walk { parking { name, lat, lng, price_amount, per }, shape, via, url }.

kind.description: With placeId: give the place its kind in plain words, one of: campsite, farm, aire, private, hut, wild, hotel, cabin, start, plane, train, bus, boat, bike, parking, hike, lift, restaurant, lake, nature, viewpoint, church, market, village, groceries, cafe, fuel, health, water, theatre, concert, wine, beer, pool, sport, tourist_office, library, zoo, activity. The plugin moves it to the trip category for that kind, so its pictogram on the map follows; its colour comes from its booking (vanlife_night).

filter.description: List (no placeId): nights = the nights of the scope; missing_contacts = no e-mail, phone, WhatsApp or own website; missing_amenities = those with a key amenity unknown; all = every place (scope ignored); hikes = each hike with its car park and walk (km, minutes).

scope.description: Which nights the list covers: planned = places with a lodging in the trip (default); candidates = night-category places with no lodging; all_nights = both.

per.description: Unit of the price: night, person, person_night, day, hour, entry (a visit), vehicle, flat (lump sum, no unit); null = not said (a night place then reads per night).

price_note.description: Free price formula, shown instead of the unit, e.g. "free 2 h, then 5 €/h", "donation".

visit_min_minutes.description: Least time on site of a visit (museum, lake, hike), in minutes; summed into the day.

access_before.description: Timed access: arrive before this local time, the road (toll road, pass, valley) is closed to cars after it. null erases.

access_after.description: Timed access: cars only after this local time. With an earlier access_before, closed in between; with a later one, open in between.

booking_required.description: true = a booking is required to get in (time slot, car park, road permit); null = not known.

booking_url.description: http(s) address where the booking is made.

booking_note.description: Short booking detail, e.g. "30-min slots, book 2 days ahead".

toll_amount.description: Toll or access ticket per vehicle (mountain toll road, park entry); added to that day's budget.

toll_currency.description: 3-letter ISO code of the toll; default: the place's or trip's currency.

closed_from.description: Closed for the season from YYYY-MM-DD (included); a stop or night planned then is blocking.

walk.description: A hike, from a car park "P" back to it: { parking_place_id (a car park of the trip) or parking (a new one: { name, lat, lng, price_amount, per, day_number }), shape: "loop" or "out_and_back" (to the hike's place and back), via: up to 8 [lat, lng] points it passes, url: full track page (Outdooractive, Komoot, Wikiloc, AllTrails) }. Never P to another P.

source.description: Where the amenities and prices come from (dated today).

parking.description: A car park (price above, per "day"/"hour"; height: max_height_m): { hours, payment, camper_allowed, overnight_allowed: yes/no/unknown, notes, source_url }.

contacts.description: The host's contacts, null erases a field: email, phone (+39 0471 000000), whatsapp, website (http), contact_name, languages (["it", "de"]), preferred_channel (email | phone | whatsapp | website_form), notes (short).

log.description: One exchange with the host, added to the place's log. Record a message as "sent" only once the user has sent it.

summary.description: One short sentence: what was asked or answered.

clear_fields.description: Clear only these: a key of set (an amenity, dog_fee, per, walk...; the price: set.price_amount null), a contact field, amenities / contacts / log, or all.

sheet_set.description: Write "sheet" fields into the notes: { field: "text" }, null removes, a list 1 item per line.

fill.description: Fill empty amenities and contacts: the place given by placeId, or the next 20 places of the trip; call again while "remaining" is above 0. Never overwrites a recorded value.

mcpTools.name: vanlife_night
mcpTools.title: Status of each night: spotted, contacted, booked, dropped
mcpTools.description: Where each night of the trip stands, kept in TREK's own bookings. Statuses: spotted (a place with no booking), contacted (booking "pending": the host was asked), booked (booking "confirmed", with its confirmation number when there is one), dropped (booking "cancelled", with a short reason). action "list": one line per evening (status, contact, last exchange, party price per night and per stay, days waiting); later evenings of a stay carry "continues", so counts are nights; "unlinked" = a booking tied to no night of the plan. action "set": placeId + dayNumber (or date) + status: creates or updates the hotel booking of that place and evening; an evening with no stay gets one (nights, default 1), and an unlinked booking of the place is tied to it. "notes" replaces the free notes. Use it after the user says they asked, booked or gave up a place. This only records what the user declares: it never books, pays or contacts anyone; never set "booked" unless the user says the host confirmed.

placeId.description: set: the place of the night.

dayNumber.description: set: the day whose evening the night starts.

dayId.description: set: TREK day id, instead of dayNumber.

date.description: set: the date of that evening, instead of dayNumber.

kind.description: set: also give the place its kind in plain words (e.g. "farm" for an agricamping, "campsite", "aire", "hotel", "wild"; the full list is in vanlife_place): the plugin moves it to the trip category for that kind, so its pictogram and colour follow. "A farm we booked" = kind farm + status booked.

confirmation.description: set booked: the host's confirmation number or reference.

reason.description: set dropped: why, in a few words (full, no tents, too expensive...).

notes.description: set: notes written on the booking.

nights.description: set, when the day has no night yet: how many nights (default 1).

mcpTools.name: vanlife_host_message
mcpTools.title: Draft the information request to a night's host
mcpTools.description: Drafts the message asking the host of a night what is still unknown: rooftop tent (or van) accepted, dog and its supplement, open on the date, estimated arrival time, price, water and electricity when useful. Uses the dates of the night and the crew from the settings (travellers, dog, vehicle). Text in English, then a line of dashes, then the language of the user (option language_extra adds the language of the host). Returns the recipient (known contact and preferred channel), a subject, the text and the list of questions. It is a request for information, not a booking. It SENDS NOTHING: show the user the exact text and wait for their explicit validation before it is sent; never send, book or pay on their behalf. After the user sends it, record it with vanlife_place log and vanlife_night status "contacted".

dayNumber.description: The evening of the night (default: the day the place is planned as a night).

nights.description: Number of nights (default: the planned ones, else 1).

arrival.description: Estimated arrival (default: the planned time of the night in the day).

language_extra.description: Add the host's language after the user's (TREK language code).

signature.description: Name to sign with, if the user gives one.
